faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before you start streaming.
faq.a1: StreamVerse is a premium OTT streaming platform offering unlimited access to movies, anime, web series, K-Drama, sports and live events. It is powered by a production-grade billing engine for seamless subscription management.
faq.q2: How does the 7-day free trial work?
faq.a2: Start a 7-day free trial on any plan. You get full premium access during the trial. You are only charged after the trial ends. Cancel anytime before the trial expires — no questions asked.
faq.q3: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
faq.a3: Yes. Cancel from your dashboard at any time. There are zero cancellation fees, no contract lock-ins, and no hidden charges. You retain access until the end of your current billing cycle.
faq.q4: How do plan upgrades and downgrades work?
faq.a4: Upgrades take effect immediately. Prorated credits for your remaining current cycle are applied automatically. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle — no access is lost early.
faq.a5: We accept major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex), UPI, net banking and digital wallets. All transactions are encrypted and processed securely.
faq.q6: Will I receive invoices for my payments?
faq.a6: Yes. Tax-compliant PDF invoices are generated automatically after every payment — including trial activations, renewals and plan changes. They are emailed instantly and accessible from your account history.
faq.q7: How many screens can I watch on simultaneously?
faq.a7: This depends on your plan. Basic supports 1 screen, Standard supports 2, Premium supports 4 screens, and the Family plan supports up to 6 simultaneous screens.
